lessons.title: 主语、宾语、表语和同位语从句

questions.stem: ____ he said at the meeting surprised everyone.
questions.explain: 主语从句里 said 缺宾语，要用既引导从句又在从句中作成分的 what（= the thing that）。that 只起连接作用，不作成分。
questions.verify: 本单元按“名词性从句”编写，教材各单元的语法项目未核实；请对照教材目录核对。

questions.stem: ____ he will come or not is still unknown.
questions.explain: 表示“是否”引导主语从句、放在句首时只能用 whether，不能用 if；后面的 or not 也说明是“是否”。

questions.stem: The news ____ our team had won the game made us very happy.
questions.explain: 从句 our team had won the game 成分完整，说明 news 的具体内容，是同位语从句，用 that。which 引导定语从句时要在从句中作成分。

questions.stem: The question is ____ we should start the project now or wait until next year.
questions.explain: 表语从句里有“现在开始还是明年再说”两种选择，表示“是否”，用 whether…or…。

questions.stem: I want to visit Mr. Wang. Can you tell me ____?
questions.explain: 宾语从句要用陈述语序（疑问词 + 主语 + 谓语），不能用疑问句语序；where 本身作地点状语，后面不再加 in。

questions.kp: It is said that… 句型
questions.stem: It is said ____ the new bridge will be finished next year.
questions.explain: It is said that… 意为“据说……”，it 是形式主语，真正的主语是 that 引导的从句。

questions.stem: The fact ____ he is a good teacher is known to all.
questions.explain: 从句 he is a good teacher 成分完整，说明 fact 的内容，是同位语从句，用 that，不能省略。

questions.stem: I was surprised at ____ she did in the end.
questions.explain: 介词 at 后接宾语从句；从句 she did 缺 did 的宾语，用 what（= the thing that）。
